verdict.rationale: Attio's own marketing describes native in-product AI that produces insights and suggestions from workspace data. "Ask Attio" answers questions using live data from every pipeline conversation. AI flags buying signals and blockers during calls, drafts account briefs and follow-ups, and agents score leads against your ICP, surface next-best customers and flag coaching moments. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how the insight and suggestion features work and what data they draw on, plus independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is marketing-page copy).
